SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. B. REC.
Section. B, Special Branch. XXXXX
REPORT
Date April 12, 1935.

Subject: Conference of Far Eastern Groups of Turko-Tartar
Separatist Movement in the U.S.S.R.
Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky    Forwarded to A.P. Smeeton 9/4

With reference to the endorsement of the Deputy
Commissioner (Special Branch) on the attached report regarding
the Nanking conference of Turko Tartar Separatist groups in
the Far East, I have endeavoured to ascertain the names of the
Moslem students who were expelled from the Nanking University
for being in communication with Galassi Iskhaki, but without
success.

G. Tcheremshansky.
D. S.

Deputy Commissioner (Special Branch)

Supt. Jan,
Could you please assist in
this matter ?
J.M.

主题：苏联境内突厥-鞑靼分离主义运动远东团体的会议。
由 D.S. Tcheremshansky 撰写    转呈 A.P. Smeeton 9/4

关于副总督察（特务科）在附呈的关于南京举行的远东突厥-鞑靼分离主义团体会议报告上的批注，本人曾试图查明因与 Galassi Iskhaki 联络而被南京大学开除的穆斯林学生姓名，但未获成功。

G. Tcheremshansky.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S. B. REGISTRY.
File No. D 6487
S. 2, special branch. 15 2 135
REPORT
Date February 19, 1935.

Subject Conference of Far Eastern Groups of Turko-Tartar Separatist
Movement in the USSR.
Made by D.S. Tcheremshunsky. Forwarded by [签名]

Information has been received to the effect that on
February 4, 1935 a conference was opened at Mukden of
representatives of various Turko-Tartar groups in the Far East
favouring the separatist movement of the Turko-Tartar tribes
in the USSR.

The conference in question was convened on the
initiative of a certain Gaiazi Iskhaki, who is reported to be
the leader of the movement. This individual arrived in the
Far East from Germany about one year ago. While in Germany
he published in Berlin a magazine and various pamphlets pertaining
to the Turko-Tartar separatist movement in Russia, in which
activities, it is reported, he was supported by the German
Government. He is also the author of a book entitled "Idel
Ural", advocating the establishment of an independent Turko-
Tartar state "Idel Ural", which, according to Iskhaki, should
include the Volga and Ural regions, Russian and Chinese Turkestan
and a part of Siberia.

It is reported that the Turko-Tartar separatist
movement is supported by the Japanese military, who, in the event
of war with the USSR, propose to utilise this movement for
fostering an uprising among the Turko-Tartar tribes in that
country. In this connection it is of interest to note that
two members of the group of Moslem students, who are being
educated at the expense of the National Government at the
University of Nanking (File H. 1088), were expelled recently,
because it had been discovered that they were in communication
with Gaiazi Iskhaki, who is said to be in the pay of the Japanese.

The following persons were elected by the local groups
of Turko-Tartar separatists to represent them at the conference:

S. 2，特务科。15 2 135
报告
日期：1935年2月19日。

主题：苏联境内突厥-鞑靼分离主义运动远东团体的会议。
由 D.S. Tcheremshunsky 撰写。由 [签名] 转呈

据收到的消息，1935年2月4日，在沈阳召开了一次会议，与会者为远东地区各突厥-鞑靼团体的代表，这些团体支持苏联境内突厥-鞑靼部落的分离主义运动。

此次会议是由一位名为 Gaiazi Iskhaki 的人发起召开的，据报道此人是该运动的领导人。此人约于一年前从德国抵达远东。在德国期间，他在柏林出版了一份杂志以及各种有关俄国突厥-鞑靼分离主义运动的小册子，据报道，他在这些活动中得到了德国政府的支持。他还著有一本名为《Idel Ural》的书，主张建立一个独立的突厥-鞑靼国家“Idel Ural”，据 Iskhaki 称，该国应包括伏尔加和乌拉尔地区、俄属及华属突厥斯坦以及西伯利亚的一部分。

据报道，突厥-鞑靼分离主义运动得到日本军方的支持，日军计划在与苏联发生战争时，利用该运动在该国突厥-鞑靼部落中煽动起义。就此而言，值得注意的是，两名在国立政府资助下于南京大学就读的穆斯林学生小组的成员（档案 H. 1088），最近被开除，因为发现他们与 Gaiazi Iskhaki 有联络，据说此人受雇于日本人。

以下人员由当地突厥-鞑靼分离主义团体选出，代表其出席会议：

                 - 2 -                Date.__________19
Subject....................................................................................
Made by................................................Forwarded by........................................
1) Kashaf Saliahmetoff. Prior to his arrival in Shanghai a
few years ago he was employed for about 10 years with Churin
& Co., a well known Russian firm in Harbin. It is reported
that he was a Soviet citizen until recently, when he took
out emigrant's passport at the local Public Safety Bureau.
He left for Mukden on 27.1.35 in s.s. 'Hoten Maru'. While
at Shanghai he resided at No. 10 Harmony Terrace, Avenue
Joffre.
2) R. Fatkullin, a draughtsman by occupation, formerly was an
officer in the "White" Russian Army in Siberia. On January
30, 1935 he left for Mukden in s.s. 'Tsingtao Maru'. While
at Shanghai he resided at No. 330 Rue Cardinal Mercier.
Most of the local Turko-Tartars are members of the
Turko-Tartar Society in Shanghai, which is strongly opposed to
the separatist movement referred to above. A letter was
published in the "Slovo" of February 7, 1935 by B. Bigmuhamodoff,
Chairman of the Society, to the effect that his organization
has no connection whatsoever with the Mukden Conference.
In addition to the support which has been accorded
by certain groups of German nationalists to the Turko-Tartar
separatist movement in Russia since the Great War, it is
reported that this movement is favoured and financially supported
by Poland as well.

（左侧批注：）
A. Tcheremshansky.
S.R.
15/2 S.I.

（右侧签名及批注：）
G. Tcheremshansky
D. S.

as to their activities.
J.P.S. FEB. 18 1935.

D. C. (Special Branch).

1) Kashaf Saliahmetoff。在几年前抵达上海之前，他曾在哈尔滨一家著名的俄国公司 Churin & Co. 任职约10年。据报道，他直到最近还是苏联公民，随后在当地公安局申领了移民护照。他于1935年1月27日乘坐“Hoten Maru”号轮船前往沈阳。在上海期间，他居住在霞飞路 Harmony Terrace 10号。
2) R. Fatkullin，职业为绘图员，曾任西伯利亚“白”俄军队军官。他于1935年1月30日乘坐“Tsingtao Maru”号轮船前往沈阳。在上海期间，他居住在迈尔西爱路（Rue Cardinal Mercier）330号。
大多数本地突厥-鞑靼人都是上海突厥-鞑靼协会的成员，该协会强烈反对上述分离主义运动。协会主席 B. Bigmuhamodoff 在1935年2月7日的《Slovo》报上发表了一封信，大意是其组织与沈阳会议毫无关联。
除了某些德国民族主义团体自大战以来一直给予俄国突厥-鞑靼分离主义运动的支持外，据报道，波兰也 favoring 并在财政上支持该运动。

（左侧批注：）
A. Tcheremshansky.
S.R.
15/2 S.I.

（右侧签名及批注：）
G. Tcheremshansky
D. S.
